title: Observability Glance: compact latency & cost strip for Quickstart
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and produce a compact ‘glance strip’ card used across the Quickstart and first-run flows that surfaces three primary observability signals: 99th percentile latency sparkline, cost-per-token microbar, and a condensed trace sparkline with top-level error badge. Deliver responsive PNG and SVG assets, annotated Figma frames for docs, and a short copy deck for engineers and docs writers. The strip must be readable at 320px width and scale cleanly to wide hero widths. This ticket covers design exploration, developer handoff assets, and one hero screenshot capturing live data from staging.
acceptance_criteria: Three visual variants produced: compact (320px), standard (720px), and hero (1200px)
Each variant includes: latency sparkline with p50/p95/p99 markers, cost-per-token microbar with tooltip annotation, and condensed trace sparkline with an error badge when traces exceed threshold
Annotated Figma frames with export-ready layer names and color tokens documented
PNG and SVG exports for all variants plus a high-res hero screenshot for docs
Design review signed off by PM and one backend engineer; handoff PR created with asset links
assets: glance_strip_hero_v1.png - hero screenshot with staging data
export-readme.md - export rules, naming and color token mapping
